prompt:
Analyze this CAPA: NC Description: 'During ISO 14001 surveillance audit, auditor found that environmental aspects register has not been updated since initial certification 2 years ago. Three new processes added (powder coating, acid etching, solvent degreasing) are not evaluated. No evidence of lifecycle perspective consideration for any aspect.'

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- rootCause (string): identified root cause of the issue
- actions (string): corrective and preventive actions
- evidence (string): evidence required for verification

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"rootCause":"Lack of defined process for regular review and update of the environmental aspects register, coupled with insufficient training or awareness among staff regarding the importance of maintaining the register.","actions":"1. Establish a scheduled review process for the environmental aspects register to be conducted at least annually. 2. Conduct a thorough evaluation of the three new processes (powder coating, acid etching, solvent degreasing) for their environmental impacts and update the register accordingly. 3. Incorporate a lifecycle perspective in the evaluation of all environmental aspects. 4. Provide training to relevant staff on the importance of maintaining the environmental aspects register and the procedures for updates.","evidence":"1. Documented procedure for the scheduled review of the environmental aspects register. 2. Updated environmental aspects register including evaluations of the three new processes with a lifecycle perspective. 3. Training records indicating staff have been informed and trained on the maintenance and update procedures of the environmental aspects register. 4. Minutes from meetings or emails showing communication and implementation of the new review process."}
